column2: WARNING Transformer Radiator Drain Sign – Hot Oil Can Spray From Drain – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:
Hot Oil Can Spray From Drain. This WARNING Transformer Radiator Drain sign from CGAP Safety reads: TRANSFORMER RADIATOR DRAIN / HOT OIL CAN SPRAY FROM DRAIN / ISOLATE AND COOL OIL CIRCUIT / RELIEVE PRESSURE PER PROCEDURE. Written for electric utilities, power generation.

Why this sign matters

Hot insulating oil under residual pressure can spray from the drain when it is opened and burn skin and eyes.

Where to post it

Mount beside the radiator drain valve on the transformer radiator bank.

Who orders it

Safety manager or maintenance supervisor at electric distribution utilities.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards to review for your site: OSHA 1910.147; ANSI Z535.2. A sign supports your safety program; it does not replace guarding, lockout or training.
